name: AI Security Monitoring | Ranime Jemal Agency

parameters.content:
## AI Security Monitoring
Receives alerts from Wazuh, Grafana/Alertmanager, AWS GuardDuty (via EventBridge) or any tool that can POST JSON. Repeats are muted for 30 minutes, public IPs are checked on VirusTotal, the AI triages each alert, everything is logged, and high or critical alerts are emailed at once. A summary is emailed every Monday.
1. Fill in **Settings**. 2. Create a Header Auth credential for the webhook and give the same header to your alert sources. 3. Make a Google Sheet with an **Incidents** tab (see `incidents-sheet.csv`). 4. Connect OpenAI, VirusTotal, Google Sheets and Gmail. 5. Activate.
